solo: Peça uma frase pessoal com 2 das palavras.

facts.label: Could para pedidos
facts.sub: Use could + verbo simples para pedir com educação: Could we have the menu, please? Could you tell me…?

facts.label: Poderíamos ter…?
facts.sub: Use Could we have… para pedir algo ao garçom: Could we have the menu, please? Could we have some water? É um pedido educado e muito comum em restaurantes.

facts.label: Você poderia me dizer…?
facts.sub: Use Could you tell me… para pedir informação: Could you tell me if the soup is vegetarian? Depois de if, a frase segue na ordem normal.

compare.ask: Could we have the menu, please?
compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “Me vê a conta?” ou “Pode trazer a conta?”.
compare.tip: Diga: “Could we have the menu, please?”
compare.us: Em inglês, use Could we have…? ou Could you…? para pedir com educação. Could soa mais gentil que Can. Depois de could, o verbo fica na forma simples: Could you bring…?

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Could we have the menu? is a polite request.
Could is only used for the past.
items.why: Could is also used for polite requests.

items.s: We say please at the end of a request.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Could we have the menu? is a polite request. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Could is only used for the past. → Falso (Could is also used for polite requests.)
We say please at the end of a request. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A restaurant in Boston · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold Friday evening in Boston. Bia and her brother come to a small restaurant. They have a booking for eight o’clock. Flo, the waitress, meets them at the door. Bia wants to be polite and clear. She uses could for every request.

“Good evening! Do you have a booking, or could I find you a table?” says Flo. “We have a booking for two. Could we sit near the window?” says Bia. “Of course. Here is the menu. Could I bring you something to drink?” says Flo.
